notes: «قال أبو عبد الله قال يزيد بن هارون وبهز والجدي عن شعبة» is al-Bukhari's remark naming other transmitters at the Shu'ba level, so it is variant group 2. The «قدر صاع» wording is left out.

Abu Salama's «دخلت أنا وأخو عائشة» is a first-person account. The event is Aisha's action, which is not a saying (rule 6), so the chain stops at Abu Salama; flagged as first-person with implicit transmission.
